ResearcherAblationBench
	

ResearcherAblationBench is part of AblationBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating language models on ablation planning in empirical AI research. 
It focuses on assisting authors by testing a model’s ability to generate ablation plans based solely on a paper’s method section.
